name: Trierarchuncus
sum: The youngest known alvarezsaurid, from the end-Maastrichtian Hell Creek Formation of Montana.
holotype: Manual unguals and other bones from the Hell Creek Formation, Montana (Fowler et al. 2020).
material: Several specimens from the Hell Creek Formation, and possible specimens from the Lance Formation of Wyoming.
biology: Had short arms with one clawed digit and long legs; unguals of different maturity show that the claw changed shape with growth.
author: Fowler et al. 2020
